main.description: Invite an account; one that already asked becomes a member. Re-invites a removed account. Moderators only: the accounts its managing app names. Served by the community's managing app, at the service its ref's app names, with atproto service auth (iss the caller, aud the app, lxm this method); clients call through their PDS with atproto-proxy set to the ref's app. Any managing app may serve it: a serving app, or a PDS that manages its own communities.

key.description: The community's key within this app.

role.description: The role they join with. Absent: the community's default.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: Not a community this managing app manages.

errors.name: NotAllowed
errors.description: The caller lacks the role this needs.

errors.name: NotAdmitted
errors.description: The managing app doesn't admit this account.
